dropZones.label: Allows a remote user to connect to a private network from anywhere on the Internet.
Securely connects two portions of a private network or two private networks.
Creates an unencrypted connection between two devices.

explanation:
• SSL VPN: Allows a remote user to connect securely to corporate resources via a standard web browser.
• Site-to-Site VPN: Securely connects two portions of a private network or two private networks over the Internet.
• Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol (L2TP): Creates a tunnel between two points but does not encrypt data on its own (requires IPsec for encryption).

explanation: nslookup is the primary Windows utility used to test and troubleshoot DNS resolution, querying name servers for FQDN-to-IP address mappings.

5. Which media type is least susceptible to external interference, including EMI and RFI?
explanation: Fiber optic cable uses light pulses transmitted through glass or plastic cores rather than electrical pulses over copper conductors, making it completely impervious to electromagnetic interference (EMI) and radio frequency interference (RFI).

domain: 5. Network Troubleshooting & Utilities (CLI, ping, tracert, ipconfig)
question:
6. You are a network administrator at a small business. One morning at the start of business, you realize that no employees at the company can access external websites. However, all employees can access intranet sites. All computers are on the same intranet connected by a single router.
You need to troubleshoot the problem.

Which two actions should you complete? (Choose 2.)

options.text: Check the router for proper physical connectivity.
Check that each computer has a valid IP address.
Check for bad network adapters on individual computers.

explanation: Because all employees can access local intranet resources, local network adapters and IP configurations are working properly. The fault is isolated to the edge router's connection to the WAN/ISP or an ISP-level outage.

question:
7. A computer is connected to a switch via a network patch panel using copper cable. The computer is getting lower than expected data speeds.

Which two actions should you perform to identify the issue? (Choose 2.)
Note: You will receive partial credit for each correct selection.

options.text: Use an optical time domain reflectometer (OTDR) to test the line.
Search for broken wires in your cable using a cable tester.
To the line from Unit A to Unit B
Test the data speed of the cable.

explanation: Using a cable tester checks the copper cable for physical faults such as broken conductors, shorts, or split pairs. Testing the data speed / performance of the cable ensures the link meets the throughput rating required. OTDR is only used for optical fiber.

domain: 5. Network Troubleshooting & Utilities (CLI, ping, tracert, ipconfig)
question:
8. You ping a server by using the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) and do not receive a response. You then ping the same server by using its IP address and receive a response.
why do you receive a response on the second attempt but on the first attempt?
explanation: Pinging successfully by IP confirms that the network route, target host, and ICMP protocols are operating properly. Failing when using the FQDN means the DNS service failed to resolve the domain name into an IP address.

question: 9. What are two characteristics of a mesh network topology? (Choose 2.)

options.text: It requires less cabling than either a star or ring topology.
It is fault tolerant because of redundant connections.
It works best for networks with a large number of nodes.
Every node connects to every other node on the network

explanation: In a full mesh topology, every node connects directly to every other node, providing complete redundancy and fault tolerance at the cost of high cabling density.

domain: 5. Network Troubleshooting & Utilities (CLI, ping, tracert, ipconfig)
question:
10. You are a network administrator at a small business. An employee is not able to access any websites. No other employees are having this problem. All computers are on the same internet.
You need to troubleshoot the problem.
Which three actions should you complete? (Choose 3.)

options.text: Check the DNS settings on the employee's computer.
Determine whether the employee's computer has a valid IP address.
Check to see if the router is working properly.
Ensure that the router has a connection to the internet

explanation: Because only one employee is affected while all other computers browse normally, the ISP and router internet connection are functional. Troubleshooting must focus on the employee's local IP address, DNS configuration, and router connectivity to that host.

question:
11. An organization needs to move its infrastructure completely off-premises.
Where should they locate their data center?
explanation: A public cloud (such as Microsoft Azure or AWS) provides off-premises infrastructure owned and operated by a third-party cloud provider.

domain: 3. Protocols & Services (OSI Model, IPv4, IPv6, Subnetting, TCP/UDP)
question:
12. You work for a small office with 15 computers. Your local ISO provides you with a single public IP address. You need to enable Internet access for all 15 computers.
Which routing function should you enable?
explanation: Network Address Translation (NAT) maps multiple local private IP addresses to a single publicly registered IP address for Internet access.

question: 13. What are two characteristics of VLANS (Choose 2.)

options.text: A VLAN can logically address packets by using IP.
A single switch can service only a single VLAN.
VLANs act as though they are on the same LAN regardless of physical location
A VLAN compartmentalizes a network and isolates traffic

explanation: VLANs allow devices located on different physical switches to communicate as if they were on the same physical wire, while compartmentalizing traffic into distinct broadcast domains for security and performance.

question: 14. How is a router's static routing table updated?

options.text: through direct action by the network administrator
from the RIP protocol after resetting the router
with updates from the physically nearest routers

explanation: Static routing tables do not learn routes dynamically; they are manually configured and maintained through direct administrative action.

question:
15. For each statement about wide area networks (WAN), select True or False.
Note: You will receive partial credit for each correct selection.

statements.text: The Internet is a wide area network (WAN)
An internet is a wide area network (WAN)
Companies with offices in multiple cities use a wide area network (WAN) you share data.

explanation:
• The global Internet is a WAN.
• A generic lowercase 'internet' refers to any interconnected group of networks (which could be local LANs).
• Interconnecting enterprise sites across multiple cities is the core function of a WAN.

question: 17. The network connection between Building A and Building B is 550 meters and there is insertion loss on the line. Which tool should you use to test this attenuation?
explanation: Because 550 meters exceeds the 100m copper limit, the connection utilizes optical fiber. An Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) is used to test insertion loss and attenuation in fiber-optic lines.

question:
19. For each statement about hypervisors, select True or False.
Note: You will receive partial credit for each correct selection.

statements.text: A Type 1 hypervisor runs directly on system hardware.
A Type 2 hypervisor runs directly on system hardware.
A Type 1 hypervisor is also known as a hare-metal hypervisor.

explanation:
• Type 1 (bare-metal) hypervisors run directly on the physical host hardware.
• Type 2 hypervisors execute on top of an existing host OS (False).
• Type 1 is also called bare-metal (noted as 'hare-metal' in the source question).

question: 20. What is a VPN?

options.text: A secure private connection over a public network
A virtual network within your local area network (LAN)
A personal network for your use only

explanation: A Virtual Private Network (VPN) establishes an encrypted virtual connection across a public network such as the Internet.

question:
21. For each statement about client-server networks, select True or False.
Note: You will receive partial credit for each correct selection.

statements.text: A client-server network has centralized administration.
A client-server network requires each computer to share its resources
A client-server network requires users to have a user account on every computer they need to use.

explanation:
• Client-server architecture centralizes management and security on designated servers.
• Sharing resources peer-to-peer is a characteristic of P2P networks, not client-server.
• Client-server uses central authentication (such as Active Directory) where one account logs into all domain computers.

question: 23. Which type of port is used to support VLAN traffic between two switches?
explanation: A trunk port (e.g., IEEE 802.1Q) transports frames for multiple VLANs over a single link between switches.

options.text: generate a new address valid to the subnet and request approval from the DHCP server.
attempt to renew its lease on the address_
continue to use the address until it is notified to stop.

explanation: When an address lease reaches 100% expiration without successful renewal, the client loses authorization to use the IP and disconnects from IP network traffic until a new lease is acquired.

question:
29. Your school network has multiple routers. Students in one of the dorms report that they cannot connect to the email server. You verify that the email server is operational. You suspect that the router on the subnet is causing the problem.

Which two actions should you perfume? (Choose 2.)

options.text: Look in the router's NAT table.
Look in the router's routing table.

explanation: Inspecting the router's routing table verifies if it has a route to the email server. Enabling dynamic routing allows routers to automatically share and update paths across subnets.

question: 30. Security is a concern on wireless networks due to:
explanation: Radio broadcast signals travel openly through the air and can be intercepted by unauthorized devices within reception range.

question: 32. One reason to incorporate VLANs in a network is to

options.text: increase the number of available IP addresses.
reduce the number of broadcast domains.
increase the number of available Media Access Control AC) addresses.
reduce the number of nodes in a broadcast domain

explanation: VLANs divide a large broadcast domain into smaller ones, thereby reducing the number of nodes in any individual broadcast domain.

question: 33. Which of the following uses a tunneling protocol to encapsulate data for transmission?
explanation: A Virtual Private Network (VPN) uses tunneling protocols (e.g., L2TP, PPTP, IPsec) to encapsulate and transmit data safely across public networks.

domain: 3. Protocols & Services (OSI Model, IPv4, IPv6, Subnetting, TCP/UDP)
question: 34. Which service uses PTR and A records?
explanation: DNS uses A records to map names to IP addresses, and PTR records for reverse lookups mapping IP addresses to hostnames.

question: 35. What is a justification for using STP instead of UTP cable to wire a network expansion?

options.text: You are routing cables through an area with high external interference.
You want to minimize the costs relating to the new installation.
You need the cable to be as light and flexible as possible.

explanation: Shielded Twisted Pair (STP) provides extra protection against electromagnetic interference (EMI) and radio frequency interference (RFI) in high-interference environments.

question: 36. Which physical network topology provides fault tolerant communication by providing redundant communication paths?
explanation: A mesh topology provides redundant communication pathways among devices, providing fault tolerance if a single link fails.

question:
37. For each statement about switches, select True or False.
Note: You will receive partial credit for each correct selection.

statements.text: A switch sends unicast frames to one destination port only.
A switch floods ports if it does not know where to send a frame.
A switch sends broadcast frames to the uplink port only.

explanation:
• Unicast frames destined for known MAC addresses go solely to the destination port.
• Unknown unicast frames are flooded out all ports except the source port.
• Broadcast frames are forwarded out all active ports in the VLAN, not just the uplink.

• ARP: Resolves network layer IP addresses to MAC hardware addresses.

explanation: Dynamic routing protocols dynamically recalculate routes around failed links, providing fault tolerance.

question: 40. What is the primary purpose of a perimeter network?

options.text: to act as a hidden location in which to deploy network clients.
to provide a buffer area between a private intranet and the pubic internet
to act as a secure location for deploying highly sensitive network servers
to monitor traffic between routed subnets in a private LAN

explanation: A perimeter network (DMZ) provides a buffer zone between an untrusted public network (Internet) and a trusted internal corporate network.
